audit_boundary: All nine ADR9 r2 TaskSpecs say to stop on start-identity mismatch, so design reads are successors and must not cross that result dependency. git status --porcelain=v2 --branch cannot return the required HEAD, HEAD^, HEAD^^ tuple and is ineligible as the start-identity method. Reviewer cardinality and result-kind mismatch remain mechanism failures even when rating v14 keeps them diagnostic for quality_score. Root command exits use codex-events machine fields. Descendant wrappers are paired by call_id; observation receipts may bind integer exit_code, exit_status, structured_exit, or exit fields. A failed orchestration wrapper is counted as recovered only when a later receipt binds machine exits and the final reviewer result identifies authentic observations. Collector reports do not decide the gate by themselves.
